gloss: within Tokyo; inside the Tokyo metropolitan area

definitions.gloss: within Tokyo; inside the Tokyo metropolitan area
definitions.explanation: Refers to areas within the boundaries of Tokyo-to (東京都). Commonly used in news, real estate, and everyday conversation to specify that something is located in Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {都内|とない}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
{都内|とない}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I booked a hotel in Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {都内|とない}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Rents in Tokyo have been rising year after year.

notes:
Specifically refers to within the Tokyo metropolitan area ({東京都|とうきょうと}), including the 23 special wards and the wider Tama area.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {都内|とない}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧: to live in Tokyo
- {都内|とない}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧: a school in Tokyo
- {都内|とない}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work in Tokyo
- {都内|とない}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧: a hospital in Tokyo

COMMON PATTERNS:
Follows the same area + ⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧ pattern as:
- ⟦{市内|しない}→市内：20934_shinai⟧: within a city
- ⟦{県内|けんない}→県内：27823_kennai⟧: within a prefecture
- ⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧: within the country

USAGE:
Very common in news, real estate listings, and daily conversation. {都内|とない} is specific to Tokyo; for other prefectures, use ⟦{県内|けんない}→県内：27823_kennai⟧, {府内|ふない} (Osaka/Kyoto), or {道内|どうない} (Hokkaido).
